name: Tabatiere
source:
"Bonjour, Master.
I'm Tabatière, a breech-loading rifle born in France. Apparently, they named me that because my chamber looks like a snuffbox.

I was originally a second-line gun, so I'll leave the front-line heroics to guys like Chassepot. I'll just do my thing in the back, like a proper second-rater.

Ah, but if you need someone for cooking, feel free to rely on me, alright?
Looking forward to working with you, Master."
